# Analyze S6 seasonal patterns by class and DOY
import pandas as pd

trips = tables['trips']
# Filter S6 trips, group by class and DOY to see per-angler yield
s6_trips = trips[trips['fish_date_season'] == 6].copy()

# Aggregate by class and DOY: avg yt/angler
s6_by_class_doy = s6_trips.groupby(['cls', 'fish_date_doy']).agg({
    'yt': 'sum',
    'anglers': 'sum',
}).reset_index()
s6_by_class_doy['yt_per_angler'] = s6_by_class_doy['yt'] / s6_by_class_doy['anglers']
s6_by_class_doy = s6_by_class_doy.sort_values(['cls', 'fish_date_doy'])

# Show peaks by class
print("=== S6 Peaks by Class (top 5) ===")
for cls in ['day_1_5', 'three_quarter', 'overnight']:
    cls_data = s6_by_class_doy[s6_by_class_doy['cls'] == cls].nlargest(5, 'yt_per_angler')
    if len(cls_data) > 0:
        print(f"\n{cls}:")
        print(cls_data[['fish_date_doy', 'yt', 'anglers', 'yt_per_angler']].to_string(index=False))

# Show DOY 14-60 (early peak window)
print("\n=== Early Peak Window (DOY 14-60) - All Classes ===")
early = s6_by_class_doy[(s6_by_class_doy['fish_date_doy'] >= 14) & (s6_by_class_doy['fish_date_doy'] <= 60)].sort_values('yt_per_angler', ascending=False)
print(early[['fish_date_doy', 'cls', 'yt', 'anglers', 'yt_per_angler']].head(20).to_string(index=False))

# Show DOY 85-120 (spring tail)
print("\n=== Spring Tail (DOY 85-120) - All Classes ===")
tail = s6_by_class_doy[(s6_by_class_doy['fish_date_doy'] >= 85) & (s6_by_class_doy['fish_date_doy'] <= 120)].sort_values('yt_per_angler', ascending=False)
print(tail[['fish_date_doy', 'cls', 'yt', 'anglers', 'yt_per_angler']].head(20).to_string(index=False))

print("\n=== S6 Score Distribution by Class ===")
print(s6_by_class_doy.groupby('cls').agg({'yt_per_angler': ['min', 'mean', 'max'], 'yt': 'sum'}).to_string())
